```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# Setup

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
```

## Input file

```{r input}
summary_change <-read_delim("outputs/processed/summary_changeB.csv") 
```

## Wrangling data

```{r wrangling}
df <- summary_change|>
  filter(scen %in% c("pi_F", "ssp126_F", "ssp585_F"), !group %in% c("tcb", "fish biomass")) |>
  select(-startB,-startSD,-endB, -endSD) |>
  mutate(scen = case_when(scen == "pi_F" ~ "piControl", scen == "ssp126_F" ~ "SSP1-2.6", scen == "ssp585_F" ~ "SSP5-8.5"), group = str_to_sentence(group), esm = str_to_upper(esm))
```

## Plotting heatmap

```{r fig4, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
fig4 <- df %>%
  # Capitalize first letter and reverse order
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = rev(c(
      "Cephalopods", "Demersals", "Hakes", "Large pelagics",
      "Macrobenthos", "Marine mammals", "Mesopelagics",
      "Phytoplankton", "Seabirds", "Sharks", "Small pelagics",
      "Zooplankton")))) %>%
  mutate(scen = factor(scen, levels = c("piControl", "SSP1-2.6", "SSP5-8.5"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = scen, y = group, fill = change)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) + # REV: size deprecated
  # White text for extreme values, black for moderate
  geom_text(aes(label = round(change, 1),
                color = ifelse(change > 80 | change < -45, "white", "black")),
            size = 3.5,fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c(
      "#B2182B", "#D6604D", "#F4A582", "#FDDBC7",  # Red: -60 to 0
      "#F7F7F7",                                    # White: 0
      "#D1E5F0", "#92C5DE", "#4393C3", "#2166AC",  # Blue: 0 to 100
      "#053061"                                     # Extra dark blue: >100 (unlabeled)
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(c(-65, -40, -20, -5,
                            0, 5, 25, 50, 100, 120), from = c(-65, 120)),
    limits = c(-65, 120),  # Extended limits
    oob = scales::squish,  # Values >100 become the darkest blue
    breaks = seq(-60, 100, by = 20),  # Breaks still stop at 100
    name = "% Change") +
  facet_grid(EM ~ esm) +
  labs(x = "Climate scenario", y = "Community-level indicator") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5), 
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey70"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"))

fig4
ggsave("outputs/figures/Fig4_heatmap.pdf", fig4, width = 10, height = 8) 
```
